interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Read the FCS reference.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through the tools, pointing at each control.

interactive.label: Find FCS
interactive.tooltip: Find tools by name or description.

interactive.label: 1. Channel Definitions
interactive.tooltip: Choose the detector setup and its correlation channel pairs (ACF/CCF presets).

interactive.label: 2. Files & Steps
interactive.tooltip: Add TTTR files and choose the optional steps (photon filter, FCS merger).

interactive.label: 3. Photon / Burst Filter
interactive.tooltip: Filter photons by count rate or burst selection before correlating.

interactive.label: 4. Correlator
interactive.tooltip: Configure channels / micro-time windows and compute the correlation.

interactive.label: 5. FCS Merger
interactive.tooltip: Screen and merge the computed correlation curves.

interactive.label: 2D-FLCS ⚠
interactive.tooltip: Two-dimensional fluorescence lifetime correlation spectroscopy. 2D-FLCS is experimental; validate settings and results on known controls before using it for production analysis.

interactive.label: Lifetime-FCS Sim ⚠
interactive.tooltip: Simulate diffusing lifetime species (+ interconversion) and recover them by lifetime-filtered correlation. Lifetime-FCS simulator: a synthetic-data teaching/validation tool. The recovered curves depend on the simulated statistics.

interactive.label: Burst-wise FCS
interactive.tooltip: Per-burst fluorescence correlation.

interactive.label: Diffusion Calc
interactive.tooltip: Confocal diffusion / volume calculator.

interactive.label: Filter Calc ⚠
interactive.tooltip: Filtered-FCS lifetime filter calculator. FCS Filter Calculator is experimental and not yet validated

interactive.label: Tool help
interactive.tooltip: Read help for the selected tool.

interactive.label: Back
interactive.tooltip: Go to the previous step or tool.

interactive.label: Next
interactive.tooltip: Go to the next step or tool.

interactive.label: Detector setup
interactive.tooltip: Choose the detector setup whose logical channels are paired.

interactive.label: Public
interactive.tooltip: Only the owner may change sharing with other MMFDB users.

interactive.label: Reload
interactive.tooltip: Reload saved detector setups and presets; discard editing drafts.

interactive.label: A
interactive.tooltip: First logical detector/excitation channel.

interactive.label: B
interactive.tooltip: Second channel; identical channels make an autocorrelation.

interactive.label: new_name
interactive.tooltip: Optional unique pair name; otherwise an ACF or cross-channel label is generated.

interactive.label: Add
interactive.tooltip: Add a channel pair with the configured correlator defaults.

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Validate and persist pairs for this detector setup.

interactive.label: Apply
interactive.tooltip: Save as the active preset and notify a connected correlator when provided.

interactive.label: Delete preset
interactive.tooltip: Delete only the FCS preset; retain its detector definition.

interactive.label: Import JSON
interactive.tooltip: Import and persist a channel preset library from JSON.

interactive.label: Export JSON
interactive.tooltip: Export the full library including this current editing draft.

interactive.label: Close
interactive.tooltip: Close this native editor; exported host state preserves drafts.

interactive.label: check0
interactive.tooltip: Use this file.

interactive.tooltip: /Users/tpeulen/dev/chisurf/test/data/tttr/BH/132/BH_SPC132.spc

interactive.label: Files...
interactive.tooltip: Add TTTR files.

interactive.label: Folder...
interactive.tooltip: Add a folder: its TTTR files are correlated.

interactive.label: Database
interactive.tooltip: Add a TTTR dataset registered in the database.

interactive.label: Example
interactive.tooltip: Add a simulated FCS measurement (molecules crossing the focus in about 0.25 ms) to try the workflow on data whose answer is known.

interactive.label: All
interactive.tooltip: Tick every file.

interactive.label: None
interactive.tooltip: Untick every file.

interactive.label: Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the highlighted file from the list (the file is kept).

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Empty the list (no file is deleted).

interactive.label: Count rate/burst filter
interactive.tooltip: Correlate only the photons a count-rate or burst filter keeps (step 3).

interactive.label: FCS merger
interactive.tooltip: Screen and merge the correlation curves after correlating (step 5).

interactive.label: channel_numbers
interactive.tooltip: Detector routing channels to keep (comma/space separated; empty = all).

interactive.label: microtime_range
interactive.tooltip: Micro-time range(s) to keep, e.g. 0-2048;2048-4095.

interactive.label: min_dmt
interactive.tooltip: Lower inter-photon-time threshold.

interactive.label: use min
interactive.tooltip: Apply the lower dMT threshold.

interactive.label: max_dmt
interactive.tooltip: Upper inter-photon-time threshold; also the burst/count-rate time window.

interactive.label: use max
interactive.tooltip: Apply the upper dMT threshold.

interactive.label: enable
interactive.tooltip: Apply the burst/count-rate filter (channel/µt/dMT selections always apply).

interactive.label: min_ph
interactive.tooltip: Minimum photons per burst (burst) / max photons in window (count-rate).

interactive.label: cr_tw
interactive.tooltip: Number of photons over which the local count rate is computed (burst mode).

interactive.label: invert
interactive.tooltip: Invert the selection (keep the rejected photons).

interactive.label: fcs_preset
interactive.tooltip: A correlation pair of the detector setup's FCS presets (step 1): fills the channels, micro-time ranges and correlator settings.

interactive.label: Load filters...
interactive.tooltip: Load lifetime (FLCS) filters from a Filter-Calculator JSON, or a .npy/.npz filter matrix. Correlation then gives species auto-/cross-correlations; A/B pick species.

interactive.label: Unload
interactive.tooltip: Remove the lifetime filters and return to detector-channel correlation.

interactive.label: Filter Calc...
interactive.tooltip: Open the fFCS Filter Calculator to compute lifetime filters from decay patterns.

interactive.label: combo_a
interactive.tooltip: A logical channel of the detector setup: fills the routing channels and micro-time ranges below.

interactive.label: combo_b
interactive.tooltip: A logical channel of the detector setup: fills the routing channels and micro-time ranges below.

interactive.label: channel_a
interactive.tooltip: Comma or space-separated detector routing channels for channel A.

interactive.label: channel_b
interactive.tooltip: Comma or space-separated detector routing channels for channel B.

interactive.label: microtime_range_a
interactive.tooltip: Semicolon-separated microtime ranges for channel A: start-end;start-end.

interactive.label: microtime_range_b
interactive.tooltip: Semicolon-separated microtime ranges for channel B: start-end;start-end.

interactive.label: n_bins
interactive.tooltip: Number of linear correlation bins per cascade.

interactive.label: n_casc
interactive.tooltip: Number of multi-tau cascades.

interactive.label: n_splits
interactive.tooltip: Number of chunks to split data into for block averaging.

interactive.label: Fine
interactive.tooltip: Use the micro-time-resolved correlation grid.

interactive.label: Correlate
interactive.tooltip: Correlate the photons of the ticked files (or the filtered photons).

interactive.label: 📂 Open folder…
interactive.tooltip: Choose a folder of .cor (or legacy .json.gz) correlation curves; dropping the folder on the window does the same.

interactive.label: 🧹 Clear
interactive.tooltip: Remove every curve and the merge (the files stay on disk).

interactive.label: 📖 Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through screening the repeats and saving the merge.

interactive.label: ❓ Help
interactive.tooltip: Why repeats are screened before averaging, and what the merge assumes.

interactive.label: folder
interactive.tooltip: The folder whose curves are listed; type a path and press Enter, or drop a folder.

interactive.label: output
interactive.tooltip: The merged curve's file (Kristine .cor: lag, G, duration and count rate, standard error); the folder's name beside the folder by default.

interactive.label: 💾 Save
interactive.tooltip: Write the merge of the ticked curves to the target file.

interactive.label: Save as…
interactive.tooltip: Choose another target file and write the merge there.

interactive.label: 🚀 Add to ChiSurf
interactive.tooltip: Save the merge and add it to ChiSurf as an FCS dataset (Seidel Kristine).

interactive.label: Open
interactive.tooltip: Open TTTR photon stream file.

interactive.label: IRF
interactive.tooltip: Load an instrument-response TTTR file.

interactive.label: Sim
interactive.tooltip: Generate a synthetic two-state exchange photon stream.

interactive.label: Run
interactive.tooltip: Build 2D-FDC and resolve lifetimes.

interactive.label: dT_ms
interactive.tooltip: Macro-time lag dT at which the 2D fluorescence-decay correlation is built. Pick a value within the dynamics timescale to see lifetime cross-peaks.

interactive.label: ddT_ms
interactive.tooltip: Half-width of the macro-time lag window (ddT). Wider = more photon pairs but coarser lag resolution.

interactive.label: tmin_ns
interactive.tooltip: Lower micro-time gate (ns) for the decay axis.

interactive.label: tmax_ns
interactive.tooltip: Upper micro-time gate (ns) for the decay axis.

interactive.label: max_bins
interactive.tooltip: Block-rebin the 2D-FDC down to this many bins before inversion (speed vs resolution).

interactive.label: n_components
interactive.tooltip: Number of log-spaced trial lifetimes in the inversion basis.

interactive.label: tau_min_ns
interactive.tooltip: Smallest trial lifetime (ns).

interactive.label: tau_max_ns
interactive.tooltip: Largest trial lifetime (ns).

interactive.label: log10_reg
interactive.tooltip: Regularisation as log10(reg); 0 selects it automatically by L-curve.

interactive.label: irf_center_ns
interactive.tooltip: Centre (prompt position) of the synthetic IRF in ns. Ignored for Detect/File/None.

interactive.label: irf_fwhm_ns
interactive.tooltip: Full width at half maximum of the synthetic IRF (ns).

interactive.label: irf_shape
interactive.tooltip: Skewness of the synthetic IRF pulse (0 = symmetric Gaussian).

interactive.label: rise
interactive.tooltip: When running the 1D-MEM, scan the IRF rise position and average the distributions around the optimum (port of TK_MyMain_Search_RiseIRF_1DMEM); reduces the IRF-timing systematic.

interactive.label: corr
interactive.tooltip: After resolving the lifetimes, compute the species-resolved (lifetime-filtered) correlation and fit the interconversion relaxation time + rate matrix.

interactive.label: Simulate + Correlate
interactive.tooltip: Generate synthetic photons, build lifetime filters and calculate correlations.
What the simulation does, the formulas and their assumptions.

interactive.label: tau1_ns
interactive.tooltip: Fluorescence lifetime of species 1.

interactive.label: d1_um2_ms
interactive.tooltip: Translational diffusion coefficient of species 1. τ_D = w₀²/(4·D).

interactive.label: tau2_ns
interactive.tooltip: Fluorescence lifetime of species 2.

interactive.label: d2_um2_ms
interactive.tooltip: Translational diffusion coefficient of species 2.

interactive.label: exchange_rate_ms
interactive.tooltip: Symmetric species interconversion rate (0 = static species). Set the two diffusion coefficients equal to isolate the exchange in the cross-correlation.

interactive.label: n_photons
interactive.tooltip: Photon budget. More photons = cleaner filtered correlations (and a slower simulation).

interactive.label: seed
interactive.tooltip: RNG seed (deterministic output).

interactive.label: Run FCS
interactive.tooltip: Correlate every ticked burst file with every ticked channel pair and fit each curve.

interactive.label: Stop
interactive.tooltip: Cancel between burst files; the previous results are kept.

interactive.label: Database...
interactive.tooltip: Resolve a burst analysis dataset from MMFDB.

interactive.label: Add pair
interactive.tooltip: Add a channel pair to edit.

interactive.label: Remove pair
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected channel pair.

interactive.label: Load pairs...
interactive.tooltip: Load channel pairs, or a detector setup, from JSON.

interactive.label: Save pairs...
interactive.tooltip: Save the channel pairs with their micro-time gates as JSON.

interactive.label: Show JSON
interactive.tooltip: Show the channel pairs as JSON.

interactive.label: Export curves...
interactive.tooltip: Save the calculated data, fits and diffusion distributions as JSON.

interactive.label: Fix D
interactive.tooltip: Fix D, rₕ or Veff: that field is the input, the other two are computed and read-only.

interactive.label: Fix rₕ
interactive.tooltip: Fix D, rₕ or Veff: that field is the input, the other two are computed and read-only.

interactive.label: Fix Veff
interactive.tooltip: Fix D, rₕ or Veff: that field is the input, the other two are computed and read-only.

interactive.label: tau_us
interactive.tooltip: Diffusion correlation time τ_D.

interactive.label: D_um2_s
interactive.tooltip: Translational diffusion coefficient (read-only unless 'Fix D').

interactive.label: rh_nm
interactive.tooltip: Hydrodynamic radius (read-only unless 'Fix rₕ').

interactive.label: S
interactive.tooltip: Confocal aspect ratio (axial / lateral beam waist).

interactive.label: veff_fL
interactive.tooltip: Effective confocal volume (read-only unless 'Fix Veff').

interactive.label: temp_C
interactive.tooltip: Temperature.

interactive.label: eta_mPa_s
interactive.tooltip: Solvent viscosity; computed from the water model when 'Use water η(T)' is enabled.

interactive.label: Use water η(T)
interactive.tooltip: Use the temperature-dependent viscosity of water (Kapusta 2010 app note).

interactive.label: invN
interactive.tooltip: Inverse occupancy G(0) = 1/N; exceeds 1 for sub-single-molecule occupancy.

interactive.label: num_mols
interactive.tooltip: Average number of molecules in Veff.

interactive.label: conc_nM
interactive.tooltip: Concentration; N = 0.602214 × c_nM × Veff_fL.

interactive.label: Apply Dref
interactive.tooltip: Set D from the selected reference (scaled as chosen below) and switch to Fix D.

interactive.label: Apply with Temp/η scaling
interactive.tooltip: Scale the reference D from 25 °C water to the current temperature and viscosity (Stokes-Einstein), or use it as tabulated.

interactive.label: Apply at 25 °C (no scaling)
interactive.tooltip: Scale the reference D from 25 °C water to the current temperature and viscosity (Stokes-Einstein), or use it as tabulated.

interactive.label: Mixed...
interactive.tooltip: Open a measured mixed decay histogram or TTTR/BST files.

interactive.label: Auto-fit
interactive.tooltip: Fit the mixed decay with lifetime species or FRET states and generate the filters from the fit.

interactive.label: Unmix
interactive.tooltip: Fit non-negative component intensities to the mixed decay and compute the filters.

interactive.label: Compute filters
interactive.tooltip: Solve the selected component filters over the fit range.

interactive.label: Save project...
interactive.tooltip: Save inputs, definitions, detector IRFs, options and computed filters.

interactive.label: Load project...
interactive.tooltip: Restore a Qt or native Filter Calculator project.

interactive.label: Export results...
interactive.tooltip: Export the filters, reconstruction and metadata as JSON.

interactive.label: Pol
interactive.tooltip: Stack parallel and perpendicular detector-routing channels for anisotropy-aware filter computation.

interactive.label: AP
interactive.tooltip: Add and reject a constant afterpulse and dark-count nuisance filter.

interactive.label: IRF
interactive.tooltip: Add and reject the detector's measured or synthetic IRF as a scattered-light nuisance filter.

interactive.label: Global (stacked) detectors
interactive.tooltip: Global (stacked) multi-detector filters: use the inter-detector relative species brightness in one global filter solve.

interactive.label: Browse IRF...
interactive.tooltip: Choose a measured IRF decay histogram for the selected detector row.

interactive.label: Load...
interactive.tooltip: Open a measured mixed decay histogram or TTTR/BST files.

interactive.label: From correlator
interactive.tooltip: Adopt the sibling Correlator's files and micro-time binning.

interactive.label: fit_start
interactive.tooltip: First TAC bin included in the filter fit.

interactive.label: fit_stop
interactive.tooltip: Exclusive upper TAC bin of the filter fit.

interactive.label: Edit
interactive.tooltip: Edit the selected component's complete definition.

interactive.label: Duplicate
interactive.tooltip: Copy the selected component with every model field.

interactive.label: Add lifetime
interactive.tooltip: Add a synthetic single-exponential component.

interactive.label: Add spectrum
interactive.tooltip: Add a synthetic lifetime spectrum.

interactive.label: Add FRET species
interactive.tooltip: Add a donor-acceptor species coupled across detectors.

interactive.label: Add lifetime distribution
interactive.tooltip: Add a Gaussian lifetime distribution.

interactive.label: Add distance distribution
interactive.tooltip: Add a Gaussian distance distribution.

interactive.label: Add measured pattern...
interactive.tooltip: Load one or more reference decay files as a component.
